assertions.description: The SubApps interface binds to Window as window.subApps inside a secure isolated context (an installed IWA); Chrome 152 enables it by default there, so on an ordinary https origin this honestly fails.
window.subApps.add() exists — installs a batch of sub apps from install paths and resolves to a SubAppsAddResponse.
window.subApps.remove() exists — uninstalls sub apps by ManifestId and resolves to a SubAppsRemoveResponse.
window.subApps.list() exists — returns the ManifestId-keyed inventory of installed sub apps.
The interface is [SecureContext]: on a non-secure context window.subApps must be absent (on a secure context either state is spec-legal, since IsolatedContext also gates it).
The spec binds SubApps to Window, not Navigator: navigator.subApps must be absent regardless of context (early explainer drafts used navigator).
When bound, list() resolves to a record (object, not an array) keyed by ManifestId, per record<USVString, SubAppsListResult>.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ if (typeof window.subApps?.list !== 'function') return false; const r = await window.subApps.list(); return r !== null && typeof r === 'object' && !Array.isArray(r); })()

assertions.description: When bound, add() rejects with TypeError for paths failing the spec's valid-relative-path rules: a slash-less path and a scheme-relative '//' path must both reject before any install is attempted.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ if (typeof window.subApps?.add !== 'function') return false; const rejectsType = async (p) => { try { await window.subApps.add([p]); return false; } catch (e) { return !!e && e.name === 'TypeError'; } }; return (await rejectsType('mail/index.html')) && (await rejectsType('//evil.example/manifest.html')); })()

assertions.description: Inside a real IWA, add() must obtain express user permission: without an enterprise no-prompt policy it requires a user gesture, shows the unified confirmation prompt, and rejects with NotAllowedError when the user declines.
assertions.test: Requires an installed isolated-app:// IWA window plus a real user interaction (gesture + accepting or declining the confirmation dialog); it cannot be executed from an automated https showcase page.
